Name: Advancing Chests
Author: Koalic
Description:
Adds customizable alternate recipes for the big chest and big stone chest that use the regular and stone chests. The alternate recipes unlock after buying the original recipes. Recipe amounts can be edited with the config.

Big Chest Recipe
1 Chest
70 Wood
2 Copper Bars

Big Stone Chest Recipe
1 Stone Chest
200 Stone
